description: Chargeable weight is the higher of dead weight and volumetric weight
Volumetric weight = L x W x H (cm) / divisor; agreement may specify a different divisor
Chargeable weight rounded up to the next 0.5 kg slab
Minimum chargeable weight unless the agreement specifies otherwise
COD fee is the higher of this amount or cod_rate_pct of COD value
Percentage of COD value; COD fee = max(cod_min_fee; cod_rate_pct x COD value)
No COD fee applies to prepaid shipments
Discount applied as % of A.1 freight after chargeable weight and zone are determined
Discounts never apply to the COD fee
